name: Concentration
overview: Scripture calls believers to focus their hearts and minds on God's guidance and commands, as seen in Joshua's exhortation to sanctify themselves in anticipation of the Lord's mighty works. The Psalms affirm that God instructs and guides with attentive care, while Ecclesiastes summarizes the duty of man as fearing God and keeping His commandments. Jesus invites the weary to find rest in Him, encouraging a concentrated trust rather than dwelling on past troubles, as Isaiah advises. Romans emphasizes presenting oneself wholly to God as a living sacrifice, highlighting the centrality of dedicated concentration in the believer's service.
